subject: Post-discovery: align CTO/VP for technical handoff and pilot gating
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenhealth.com>, Rahul Mehta <rahul.mehta@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: align CTO/VP for technical handoff and pilot gating

Hi Priya and Rahul — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the ask to keep momentum: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for clinical summarization by ~40% while staying within strict PHI controls.
- Current infra: GPU-backed endpoints (in-house) with episodic load spikes; prefix caching could help for repeated patient notes.
- Success criteria for pilot: sub-200ms p95 for 2k tokens + audit logs retained 90 days + controlled training data flow.

Open gating items we heard today:
1) Leadership alignment (VP/CTO) to sign off on pilot scope & compliance guardrails.
2) A short infra checklist from your security team.
3) Demonstration of end-to-end latency on a small representative waveform (10–15 min tech deep dive).

Ask: can we schedule a 30–40 minute VP/CTO intro (executive+technical handoff) next week to lock pilot gating? Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 15 — 10:00–10:40 AM
- Wed Dec 16 — 2:00–2:40 PM
- Thu Dec 17 — 9:00–9:40 AM

Attached: short discovery notes and the pilot scope draft for review. If none of those times work, share two times that fit Rahul's/C-suite calendars and we'll route accordingly.

Attachments: discovery-notes-lumenhealth-20261208.pdf, pilot-scope-v1-lumenhealth.pdf

Thanks — happy to adjust agenda if you prefer a shorter executive-only handshake.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0172
redwood.inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rahul Mehta <rahul.mehta@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: align CTO/VP for technical handoff and pilot gating

Thanks Vanessa — great summary. Rahul and I reviewed the notes. A couple quick clarifications:
- The 200ms p95 target is ambitious but worth discussing; we want to understand tradeoffs (quantization, batching) during the tech brief.
- Security will need the data retention plan and a short list of required logs (we can surface the SOC checklist).

Rahul's availability next week is limited but he can do the following (PST):
- Wed Dec 16 — 2:00–2:30 PM (tight)
- Thu Dec 17 — 9:00–9:45 AM

If you can take Wed at 2:00, we'll make it work; otherwise Thu is our fallback. Please include any engineering leads from your side (infra/serving runtime) and Karthik if he wants to join.

I'll also start a Security request and share a short checklist by tomorrow.

Best,
Priya
Director, AI Platforms | LumenHealth
priya.shah@lumenhealth.com | (617) 555-0199

Hi Priya / Rahul — Karthik here (meant to chime in earlier). Appreciate the quick turnaround and the availability options.

We're happy to take Wed Dec 16 at 2:00 PM PST for a concise 30-minute exec+tech handshake. I'll bring our Head of Serving (Marissa) for the short technical overlay and myself for any commercial/rollout questions. Proposed agenda: 
1) 5 min — Introductions & pilot objectives (Priya)
2) 10 min — High-level serving approach + latency/quantization tradeoffs (Marissa)
3) 10 min — Pilot gating & next steps (Karthik)
4) 5 min — Q&A & calendar next steps

Vanessa — can you send the calendar invite to Rahul and Priya and include Marissa and me? Also please attach a single-slide latency summary (p95 targets + typical levers) to the invite so Rahul has a quick reference.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.
